items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He had Cliff King, and a guy named Wilson, Stanley Wilson on guitar... That's who I was talking about. Spaulding.

ctx.x: There was about seven trombone players there. Wilson was in there. Wilson was the West Indian trombone player. He was always getting in it, and he'd want to start something. "I've got something new, something that nobody has ever heard before." And it would be "Margie" in another key. Well, that was the challenge like of New York. You
